response:
I have resolved the issue where proxy authentication credentials in proxy URLs were being dropped, causing HTTP `407 Proxy Authentication Required` errors.

### Cause
In `requests.utils.prepend_scheme_if_needed`, `urllib3.util.parse_url` was used instead of `urllib.parse.urlparse`. Unlike `urlparse`, `parse_url` separates the user authentication component into `auth` rather than including it inside `netloc`. Consequently, reconstructing the URL with `urlunparse` resulted in `auth` being stripped from proxy URLs before extraction by [`get_auth_from_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79pmf7rl/requests/utils.py#L985).

### Fix
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79pmf7rl/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-79pmf7rl/requests/utils.py) to prepend `auth` to `netloc` if present before rebuilding the URL with `urlunparse`.
